# A map can hide the route

Read a chapter about survey maps and drew the route to the museum from memory. My version contains the steep kerb and the bakery smell but no scale. The official route is shorter and unusable with Mum's walker. Neither map is simply wrong; each silently assumes a traveller. Is a label like accessible doing too much work? [[Field methods]] should start with who can make the journey.
